items.name: ChildFilterPushdownResult
items.summary: The result of pushing down a single parent filter into all children.

methods.name: all
methods.summary: Combine all child results using AND logic. Returns `Yes` if **all** children support the filter. Returns `No` if **any** child rejects the filter or if there are no children.

methods.name: any
methods.summary: Combine all child results using OR logic. Returns `Yes` if **any** child supports the filter. Returns `No` if **all** children reject the filter or if there are no children.
